source.title: Fictional coordination team exercise protocol
source.quote: EXERCISE ONLY: Notify the current duty lead about an unverified priority-service disruption. If the primary does not acknowledge, use the designated alternate. If neither is reachable, notify the coordination supervisor to establish accountable follow-up; this does not delegate command authority. Preserve uncertainty, record attempts, and name a next update owner and checkpoint. Do not contact real authorities.
